No, we are not done. I think this result points to a broken eval, not a perfect agent.

4. Pull the raw judge outputs. I will check whether each one returned a real score or whether a failed parse left the 7.0 in place.

6. Add an F-numbered entry to spe/failures.md for each cause I confirm. I will keep the original numbers next to any regraded numbers in spe/prediction-log.md.

After that I will report back with the cause and the corrected numbers. If the fix needs your input, such as whether the extra 10 tickets belong in the set, I will ask you then. I will commit locally after each step and I will not push.
